The John Mason House in Lexington, Massachusetts, is associated with the First Period, circa 1715. The John Mason House in Winchester, Massachusetts, is associated with the Italianate style, built in the 1860s. The John W. Mason House in Fergus Falls, Minnesota, does not have a specific historical period mentioned in the documents.

The Elks organization was founded in 1868 in the United States, according to Document 1. However, Document 2 states that the Elks of Canada was founded in 1912, and Document 3 mentions the Improved Benevolent Protective Order of Elks of the World (IBPOEW) was established in 1897.
